an3.40:1.5: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:--
an3.40:1.6: na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:1.7: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:1.8: Api ca kho 'mhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:1.9: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā ti.
an3.40:1.10: Ahañ c' eva kho pana yādisake vā kāme ohāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito tādisake vā kāme pariyeseyyaṃ tato vā pāpiṭṭhatare, na me tam assa paṭirūpan ti.
an3.40:1.12: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan ti.
an3.40:1.13: So attānaṃ yeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti sāvajjaṃ pajahati anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an3.40:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:--
an3.40:2.3: na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:2.4: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na iti bhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:2.5: Api ca kho 'mhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:2.6: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā ti.
an3.40:2.7: Ahañ c' eva kho pana evaṃ pabbajito samāno kāmavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ vyāpādavitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ vihiṃsāvitakkaṃ vā vitakkeyyaṃ. Mahā kho panāyaṃ lokasannivāso.
an3.40:2.8: Mahantasmiṃ kho pana lokasannivāse santi samaṇabrāhmaṇā iddhimanto dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduno.
an3.40:2.9: Te dūrato pi passanti āsannā pi na dissanti cetasā pi cittaṃ jānanti.
an3.40:2.11: passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī ti.
an3.40:2.12: Devatā pi kho santi iddhimantiniyo dibbacakkhukā paracittaviduniyo.
an3.40:2.13: Tā dūrato pi passanti āsannā pi na dissanti cetasā pi cittaṃ jānanti.
an3.40:2.15: passatha bho imaṃ kulaputtaṃ saddhā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito samāno vokiṇṇo viharati pāpakehi akusalehi dhammehī ti.
an3.40:2.17: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho hoti samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan ti.
an3.40:2.18: So lokaṃ yeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati kusalaṃ bhāveti sāvajjaṃ pajahati anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an3.40:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññāgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati:--
an3.40:3.3: Na kho panāhaṃ cīvarahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito
an3.40:3.4: na piṇḍapātahetu na senāsanahetu na itibhavābhavahetu agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajito.
an3.40:3.5: Api ca kho 'mhi otiṇṇo jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi dukkhotiṇṇo dukkhapareto
an3.40:3.6: appeva nāma imassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa antakiriyā paññāyethā ti.
an3.40:3.7: Svākkhāto Bhagavatā dhammo sandiṭṭhiko akāliko ehipassiko opanayiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhi.
an3.40:3.8: Santi kho pana me sabrahmacārī jānaṃ passaṃ viharanti.
an3.40:3.9: Ahañ c' eva kho pana evaṃ svākkhāte dhammavinaye pabbajito samāno kusīto vihareyyaṃ pamatto na me taṃ assa paṭirūpan ti.
an3.40:3.11: kho pana me viriyaṃ bhavissati asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan ti.
an3.40:3.12: So dhammaṃ yeva ādhipateyyaṃ karitvā akusalaṃ pajahati . . . pe . . . anavajjaṃ bhāveti suddhaṃ attānaṃ pariharati.
an3.40:3.14: Imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi ādhipateyyānī ti. 4.
